content.text:
- `web/src/courses/operations.ts:72-78,176-215` — `operationNeedsCurrentRevision()` excludes non-commutative `card.upsert`, `submission.save`, and `submission.review`, while those entities have no checked base version. Two edits from the same `baseRevision` are both accepted, and the later operation silently overwrites the earlier card, answer, or review. `submission.version` merely increments after overwrite and cannot detect the conflict because the operation contract has no `baseVersion`. Include these operations in course-revision checks or add/check entity-level base versions. Severity: 4/5. Confidence: 0.99.

- `web/src/courses/operations.ts:154-171` — The shared-note optimistic-lock algorithm checks `baseVersion` only when the note already exists: `if (existing && existing.version !== operation.baseVersion)`. A write for a missing note with `baseVersion: 3` is accepted and recreated as version 1, even though its stated base never existed. Compare `operation.baseVersion` against `existing?.version ?? 0`, rejecting any nonzero base for creation. Severity: 3/5. Confidence: 0.99.

- `web/src/courses/operations.ts:178-195,203` — Submission identity is inconsistent. Save looks up `(submissionId, actorAccountId)`, so a second learner can reuse another learner’s ID and append a duplicate; review then uses only `submissionId` and reviews whichever duplicate occurs first. Enforce globally unique submission IDs and reject an ID owned by another account, or use the same composite key in every operation. Severity: 4/5. Confidence: 0.98.

- `web/src/courses/operations.ts:126-128`; `web/src/courses/contracts.ts:317-324` — `lesson.update` searches only the requested module, allowing the same lesson ID to be inserted into multiple modules. Progress is keyed solely by lesson ID, but completion divides unique completed IDs by the raw lesson-array length; duplicated IDs therefore become impossible to track independently and can report 50% when the sole identifiable lesson ID is completed twice. Enforce course-wide lesson-ID uniqueness/move semantics and calculate against the same unique identity set. Severity: 3/5. Confidence: 0.96.

- `web/src/courses/operations.ts:183-193` — Saving a changed answer unconditionally carries forward `existing.review`. The submission version and answer advance, but its prior `"reviewed"` status and feedback remain attached to content the teacher never reviewed. Clear the review or transition it back to `needs-review` whenever the answer changes. Severity: 3/5. Confidence: 0.97.
